claim: A key of Kegels, focus on the rear: different ways of doing Kegels have dramatically different impacts, especially on your sex life
Three muscles are involved in Kegels: the bulbocavernosus (BC), the pubococcygeus (PC) and the iliococcygeus (IC)
The technical names of the Kegel muscles don't really matter: what matters is where they sit and which you focus on
Of the Kegel muscles, going from the front to the back, and up as you go back, the BC is the most in front, kind of under your balls
Of the Kegel muscles, going from the front to the back, the PC is in the middle
Of the Kegel muscles, going from the front to the back, and up as you go back, the IC sits further back, against the coccyx bone, so when you squeeze it you can almost feel it in your super low back
In Kegels, focusing forward, on the PC and especially the BC, is much less effective for controlling your arousal level, with a much different impact on your sex life than the deeper, rear muscles
Personally found: of the Kegel muscles, the deeper and more towards the back, the bigger the muscles, with greater control

Personally found: the smaller BC and PC a lot of times don't give the ability of greater control, and without the biggest, most powerful Kegel muscles, the IC towards the rear, you don't get the same impact
Highly suggested for Kegels: still imagine stopping the flow of urine, or holding in a fart, but feel the squeeze towards the back, against the coccyx bone in your super low back, the ideal place
Feeling the Kegel squeeze towards the back, against the coccyx bone, gives much greater control over your arousal
Feeling the Kegel squeeze towards the back, against the coccyx bone, gives sort of a bigger life energy impact than the BC, just under your nuts
A key of Kegels, both Kegels and reverse Kegels: reverse Kegels are incredibly impactful for the overall health of the pelvic floor, and really, really impactful for your sex life
